description: This file implements a Windows-specific communication channel for the Android Keymaster service, handling named pipe connections, message sending, and receiving with overlapped I/O operations.

classes.name: KeymasterWindowsChannel
classes.description: A class managing Windows named pipe communication for the Android Keymaster service, supporting connection handling, message transmission, and reception.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a KeymasterWindowsChannel instance with a given pipe handle.

methods.name: WaitForConnection
methods.description: Waits for a client to connect to the named pipe handle, setting up overlapped I/O and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a specified command and message payload.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a specified command and message payload.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Handles the actual message serialization and asynchronous write to the pipe.

methods.name: ReadFromPipe
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously from the pipe into a buffer, handling overlapped I/O completion.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a complete message from the pipe, including header and payload, handling large messages and errors.
